Satellite Earth imagery

Day: NASA Blue Marble Next Generation, December 2004, topography and bathymetry, 5400 x 2700.
File: earth-day.jpg
Source: https://eoimages.gsfc.nasa.gov/images/imagerecords/73000/73909/world.topo.bathy.200412.3x5400x2700.jpg
Background and credits: https://svs.gsfc.nasa.gov/2915
NASA / Goddard Space Flight Center Scientific Visualization Studio; Blue Marble by Reto Stockli (NASA/GSFC).

Night: Earth at Night 2012, 3600 x 1800; Suomi NPP VIIRS composite, released 2013.
File: earth-night.jpg
Source: https://eoimages.gsfc.nasa.gov/images/imagerecords/79000/79765/dnb_land_ocean_ice.2012.3600x1800.jpg
Background and credits: https://svs.gsfc.nasa.gov/30028
NASA Earth Observatory image by Robert Simmon, using Suomi NPP VIIRS data provided courtesy of Chris Elvidge (NOAA National Geophysical Data Center).
Suomi NPP is a partnership between NASA, NOAA, and the Department of Defense.
The source composite uses observations from April and October 2012 over existing MODIS Blue Marble imagery.

Images are locally served static composites, not live satellite captures.
The interactive globe blends these textures according to the current UTC solar position; the day/night terminator updates with time.
Solar equations reference: NOAA Global Monitoring Laboratory, General Solar Position Calculations
https://gml.noaa.gov/grad/solcalc/solareqns.PDF
This visualization is for exploration and approximate illumination, not navigation.
